target_customer: Private credit funds, originators and servicers that run middle and back office operations manually
problem: Post-investment operations at private capital managers run on spreadsheets and email, leading to errors, fines and lost LP relationships. Elimentary builds agents for borrowing base calculations, loan tape processing and NAV work.
business_model: B2B enterprise software and agent services (pricing not public)
product_category: AI agents for private credit operations

founders.name: Yogesh Gorjilla
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a Pay Later product to 10 million users and a $1 billion loan book.

founders.name: Mannat Saini
founders.background_notes: Built credit products to about 20 million users and a $1 billion loan book per YC page.

founders.name: Manoj Sarda
previous_startups: Skit.ai (voice AI for debt collection, founder; outcome not stated)

competitors.name: Ellis
competitors.what: AI-native operating platform for private credit managers
competitors.funding_then: More than $10M seed reported at launch

competitors.name: Levocred AI
competitors.what: Loan tape ingestion, borrowing base reports and covenant checks for credit funds (YC S26)
competitors.traction_then: early deployment at one asset manager per a profile

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing loan tapes and servicer reports and producing auditable borrowing base and NAV calculations requires domain logic and accuracy, but builds on current LLM tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integration and a reported multi-year partnership could create lock-in, but several well-funded startups target the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known. dv01 launched an agentic platform for structured finance in the period.

market_need_then: The company says one customer cut a 20 hour process to 30 minutes, saving about $150k a year; this is self-reported. Private credit AUM growth and manual operations are the stated drivers.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found. The name reads like a misspelling of elementary and is confused with Ellis in search results.

outcome_analysis: Elimentary is an active Fall 2026 company with no outcome yet. Its three founders come from banks, a large Indian credit platform and a prior debt collection voice AI startup, which gives it domain credibility. It enters a field where Ellis and other YC and non-YC startups were already funded, so execution and enterprise sales speed will decide the result.
notes: Dealroom lists $125K raised and does not state the stage; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. The YC page mentions a multi-year contract with TresVista, which a search could not confirm independently. The company's site is confusingly worded and says backed by Combinator. Customer claims are self-reported.
